Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning evaluating military training and experience toward meeting licensing requirements in medical professions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to evaluating military training and experiencetoward meeting licensing requirements in medical professions; adding anew section to chapter 18.29 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 18.34RCW; adding a new section to chapter 18.55 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 18.64A RCW; adding a new section to chapter 18.71A RCW; addinga new section to chapter 18.73 RCW; adding a new section to chapter18.79 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 18.84 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 18.88A RCW; adding a new section to chapter 18.89RCW; adding a new section to chapter 18.135 RCW; adding a new sectionto chapter 18.215 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 18.260 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.29 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall develop a process to evaluate militarytraining and experience that may be applied toward meeting the trainingand educational requirements of this chapter.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.34 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The secretary shall develop a process to evaluate military trainingand experience that may be applied toward meeting the training andeducational requirements of this chapter.
